{{Quote|I could do pretty well at the vine swinging.|Princess Kneesaa|<ref name="Three Cheers for Kneesaa!: An Ewok Adventure">''[[Three Cheers for Kneesaa!: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref>}}
'''Vine swinging''' was a sport practiced by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of diminutive [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] living on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. On the occasion of the Ewok [[midsummer festival]], a vine swinging contest was held, among several other sporting events. [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], the [[Prince/Legends|princess]] of the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], once entered such a vine swinging competition. When she lost hold of the vine, Kneesaa accidentally landed on a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] log and ended up winning the [[Log riding|Log Ride Contest]].
